source_snapshot.test_name_items: UID switch button ( Include Front and Rear )
source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    1. Press UID button when UID is OFF.
2. Press UID button when UID is ON.

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1. UID should be ON after press UID button when UID is off
2. UID should be OFF after press UID button when UID is on

original_test_intent: Verify the front and rear physical UID switches each toggle the chassis UID indicator from off to on and from on to off.
original_method: A qualified operator identifies each front/rear button and corresponding indicator, establishes the initial state, performs the off-to-on and on-to-off physical presses for each required control, records visual evidence and restores the approved final state.
manual_activity: An operator must press the actual front and rear switches and visually confirm the corresponding physical indicator. Remote UID control/readback cannot prove the switch path.
required_inputs: UID on/off color/blink semantics and coupled-versus-independent behavior
Initial/final UID state, operator and one-user approval
safety_requirements: Do not press an unmapped or damaged control.
Avoid simultaneous remote UID writes that could invalidate physical causality.
Preserve per-press visual and BMC/event evidence and restore the final state.
Stop on wrong indicator or unexpected chassis behavior; no automatic repeat.
agent_execution_scope: Collect read-only BMC/Redfish UID state, SEL and OOB health around each operator action.
Correlate timestamps and organize visual records for both locations/transitions.
Report observations without claiming the physical press or formal verdict.
engineer_actions: Supply the front/rear mapping and behavior rule.
Perform and visually record all physical presses.
Confirm final state and issue the verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: No command can replace the source button actions; its physical-only conclusion is applicable.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Retain manual button presses and use read-only UID state/event queries only for corroboration.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Front/rear scope, off-to-on and on-to-off transitions and both five-minute fields are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.status: RETAIN PHYSICAL TOGGLE WITH CORRELATED STATE
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use a per-button state-transition matrix with timestamped photos/video and synchronized read-only BMC UID state/event capture.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Exact chassis front/rear switch and indicator implementation.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record chassis, BMC and CPLD/LED firmware versions.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds identity, sequence and restoration traceability without substituting remote control.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No loss; both physical paths remain required.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Mapping, behavior, debounce and final state.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A shared UID state may make the second button dependent on the first sequence, so initial state must be logged.

project_override_considerations: A project may define shared or independent front/rear behavior, but must test and report each required physical control. Remote commands are not an approved substitution.
expected_evidence: Front/rear button/indicator map and state semantics
Correlated BMC/Redfish/SEL state and no unrelated indicator change
Restored final UID state and separate engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The two procedure and criteria states form a consistent toggle sequence; missing front/rear coupling detail is a readiness input.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Mapping and behavior details can be supplied and a qualified operator can perform the physical test; it is MANUAL ONLY rather than blocked.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Agree with NO and add separate front/rear identity, transition and final-state evidence.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Agree with MANUAL ONLY and its physical-proof boundary.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Keeps remote state collection separate from the physical input being tested.

review_improvement: Ensures both switch locations and both directions are independently evidenced instead of recording a generic UID toggle.
independent_technical_reasoning: The tested function is the mechanical/electrical switch path, not the BMC UID state in isolation. Only a physical press correlated with the expected visible transition proves that path, making the case MANUAL ONLY.
